title: ContextReceipt
description: Context Receipt (MODEL-SWITCHING-SCORECARD.md §41). NOT a standalone file or artifact: this schema describes the `data` object of the append-only ledger envelope event `context.compiled` (ARTIBOT-5.0-DESIGN.md §8.2 §8·§41 — Context Receipt는 context.compiled 이벤트의 data). Its purpose is to separate a model problem from a context problem: input tokens in, transform deltas, output tokens out. Ownership note from lane 2 §4.5 — cache.hit_tokens and cache.created_tokens read the SAME transcript fields as the attempt receipt, and the single writer of those numbers is economics/usage-receipt.js (design §3.6); the context module references the values, it does not re-measure them. additionalProperties is false at every level.

schema_version.description: Receipt schema revision. Bumped only on a breaking field change.

context_receipt_id.description: Unique id of this context compilation record.

mission_id.description: Mission the compiled context belongs to.

task_id.description: Optional. Task the compilation was performed for.

action_id.description: Optional. Action the compiled context was handed to.

based_on.description: Which revisions the context was compiled from (§41, Hardening §22 based_on). Monotonic counters, so a receipt compiled against a stale plan is detectable after the fact.

intent_revision.description: Intent revision the compilation was based on.

plan_revision.description: Plan revision the compilation was based on.

input_tokens.description: Token count of the context before any transform.

transforms.description: The five §41 transforms. INTERPRETATION (§41 leaves the value types blank; this is the schema's choice, stated so a consumer never has to guess): each value is a SIGNED token delta contributed by that transform — negative removes tokens, positive adds them, 0 means the transform ran and changed nothing. All five keys are required so input_tokens + sum(transforms) reconciles against output_tokens; a transform that did not run is 0, never omitted.

dedup.description: Signed token delta from de-duplication (normally negative or 0).

tool_compression.description: Signed token delta from tool-result compression (normally negative or 0).

history_trim.description: Signed token delta from history trimming (normally negative or 0).

memory_add.description: Signed token delta from injected memory (normally positive or 0). In Phase 0 memory injection is instrumented only, with defaults unchanged (design §501).

project_knowledge_add.description: Signed token delta from injected generated project knowledge (normally positive or 0).

protected_sections.description: Identifiers of sections that no transform may touch (§41). May be empty; the empty array is a statement that nothing was protected.

output_tokens.description: Token count of the compiled context handed to the model.

cache.description: Prompt-cache accounting for this compilation. Same transcript origin as AttemptReceipt.usage.cached_input_tokens and cache_creation_tokens — referenced from the single usage-receipt writer, not measured again here (lane 2 §4.5).

provider.description: Cache provider the numbers came from (e.g. anthropic).

strategy_version.description: Monotonic version of the context-compilation strategy that produced this receipt. Typed as a counter for consistency with the other revision fields (intent_revision, plan_revision, execution_profile_version); §41 leaves the type blank.
